description: Send a control/test command to a connected device via the app's sendTestCommand. Executes immediately — drives an actuator/output on the board. MUTATING.

command.description: sendTestCommand payload {config, actuator, set_value, receiver, data}; deviceId is taken from target.

target.description: Which device to target — pass exactly one field. If omitted, the app must know exactly one device; ambiguous or unmatched targets are refused.

name: flash_test
title: Send test/control command
